The '''Devastator Crate''' is a special time-limited crate. It first appears during the [[Devastator]] campaign, but also reappears later to give you another chance at purchasing.

Cost: 90 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Ballista]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Dragon]] x6 (unique to this crate)
* [[Earthshaker]] x6 (unique to this crate)
* [[S.A.W.]] x6
* [[Demon]] x12 (unique to this crate)
* [[Falcon]] x12
* [[Halefire Humvee]] x12
* [[Tomahawk]] x12
